summary_en: 300,000 shares (2.5% of S/O), ¥1.9B upper limit, open-market purchases, Aug 7–Oct 30, 2026. Rationale: capital efficiency and shareholder return enhancement toward ROE 8%+ and 100%+ three-year cumulative payout ratio under the 4th medium-term plan (FY26–28).
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Acquisition of Own Shares (Acquisition of Own Shares Based on the Articles of Incorporation Under Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, Stella Chemifa's board resolved to acquire up to 300,000 of its own ordinary shares (2.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥1.9 billion, by open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 7 August through 30 October 2026. The acquisition supports the company's 4th medium-term plan (FY26–28), which targets ROE of 8% or higher by March 2028 and cumulative shareholder distributions of 100% or more of earnings over the three-year period. The buyback is intended to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns.
